subject.title: Memory MVP: define SQLite schema and canonical record model

question: Should memory-core make typed SQLite records the durable source of truth for memory v1, and which migration, provenance, review, edit, forget, and conflict semantics must ship with it?
rationale: Current main uses Markdown as durable memory and SQLite as an index; switching the source of truth is a persistent data-model and product boundary that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned SQLite MVP model
options.body: Define a conservative memory-core schema with status, revision, provenance, and migration rules before implementing the open Memory MVP follow-ups.

options.title: Keep Markdown canonical for now
options.body: Narrow or close this direction and continue treating SQLite as search/index infrastructure around Markdown durable memory.

options.title: Defer until memory convergence
options.body: Keep the issue as design backlog until maintainers pick the recommended memory plugin path called out in VISION.md.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned SQLite MVP model
recommendation.body: Define a conservative memory-core schema with status, revision, provenance, and migration rules before implementing the open Memory MVP follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history on memory flush ownership, memory-host SDK extraction, and the storage/index model this schema would replace or migrate.
